- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:102-127 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Early rejection closes the connection before consuming the declared request body, so clients can raise `BrokenPipeError` while sending a rejected POST instead of receiving the expected HTTP 400 response.
  WHY: CI reports `test_broker_rejects_client_authorization` failing with `BrokenPipeError`; all three reviewers identify the unread body and early connection close as the cause.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 262 (root copy `_shell_segments_with_operators`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not handle redirect targets like the template copy, so `2>&1` can be parsed as a push argument.
  WHY: A redirected stderr descriptor can cause the push target to be misidentified, weakening branch-guard resolution.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 325-332 (root copy `_guarded_git_invocations`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root guard does not account for `cd || exit` before a subsequent `git push`, and may resolve the push target from the directory even when the failed `cd` prevents the push from running.
  WHY: The guard can resolve the working directory as if the `cd` succeeded although `exit` cancels the command list.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:lines 40-42 (`allowed()`) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The review isolation allowlist permits untrusted review-editor output to overwrite the host-executed merged-PR safety hook.
  WHY: A transferred editor-produced copy can replace the `PreToolUse` hook and silently disable §21 protection; the reviewer also reports this same allowlist issue under implicit-execution risks.
- agents.md:lines 72-73 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The documentation lists `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` among files admitted for snapshot and transfer.
  WHY: It tells operators the hook is transferable, so an editor build that includes it in the admitted set would not raise a review finding.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 1014 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts that the merged-PR guard hook is transferable.
  WHY: The test encodes the transfer-permit behavior and will fail when the deny logic lands.
- tests/test_claude_anthropic_relay.py:line 182 (`test_broker_rejects_client_authorization`) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The broker rejection test fails with `BrokenPipeError` while sending a POST with an Authorization header.
  WHY: The CI job is failing on this test and the finding reports that the failure blocks the required `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and aggregate `lint` checks.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
